systems.name: Business Management System

systems.name: Restaurant Management System

projects.title: School Finance Manager
projects.desc: Finance management system for school headmasters — desktop app now, with mobile and web versions in development.
highlights: Built desktop-first for headmasters' daily use
Mobile and web companion versions currently in development
Designed to expand across a school's finance workflow, not just one task

projects.title: Educational Data Exporter
projects.desc: Desktop tool that pulls data from an educational platform and exports it directly into ready-to-use Excel spreadsheets.
highlights: Pulls structured data straight from the source site — no manual copy-paste
Removes hours of manual data entry per use

projects.title: JSON-to-Excel Report Generator
projects.desc: Desktop tool that takes JSON data files and populates them into existing Excel report templates automatically.
highlights: Converts raw JSON into ready-to-send Excel reports in seconds
Works against existing templates, so output matches house formatting
Removes manual re-entry of exported data

projects.title: Lecture Timetable Builder
projects.desc: Desktop app for building and editing lecture timetables for schools, with a mobile version planned.
highlights: Built for non-technical school staff to use directly
Handles the scheduling constraints specific to lecture timetabling

projects.title: Web-to-PDF Research Tool
projects.desc: Browser extension built for journalists to extract data from web pages into clean, reliable PDFs — solving inconsistent browser print output.
highlights: Extracts page data directly into a clean PDF layout
Solves the inconsistency of standard browser print-to-PDF
Built specifically around a journalist's research workflow

projects.title: Parental Control App
projects.desc: Mobile app for scheduling device usage windows and locking access with a PIN.

highlights: Digitizes attendance tracking for a university course
